ns2:course.label: Luso-Brazilian Culture
ns2:course.description: Affords a broad understanding of the origins of Luso-Brazilian civilization and culture. 3 undergraduate hours. 2 or 4 graduate hours. Prerequisite: PORT 212 and PORT 320, or equivalent.
